questions.question: After the wall was rebuilt, God put it into Nehemiah's heart to gather the nobles, officials and people. How were they to be enrolled?
Who did Nehemiah say should be appointed as guards for the city of Jerusalem?

answers.text: Soldiers sent by the king of Persia

questions.question: Nehemiah told Hanani and Hananiah to open the gates of Jerusalem as soon as the sun came up. True or false?
When Nehemiah gathered the nobles, the officials and the people to be enrolled, what did he find?

answers.text: The register of those who first returned
A letter from the king of Persia
The scroll of the Law of Moses
